description: This source file defines a Java interface 'PostDatedChecksRepository' that extends Spring Data JPA repository interfaces, providing database access methods for 'PostDatedChecks' entities. It includes a custom query method to retrieve pending post-dated checks associated with a specific loan repayment schedule installment.

classes.name: PostDatedChecksRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for the entity 'PostDatedChecks', providing CRUD operations and custom queries related to post-dated checks.

methods.name: getPendingPostDatedCheck
methods.description: Custom query method to retrieve a pending post-dated check (status=0) associated with a specific loan repayment schedule installment.

calls: select pdc from PostDatedChecks pdc where pdc.status = 0 and pdc.loanRepaymentScheduleInstallment = :loanRepaymentScheduleInstallment
